anchors.description: Full tip-to-tail length of the upper red dry-erase marker lying on the whiteboard marker holder
anchors.visible_evidence: Red-capped dry-erase marker lying horizontally in the wall-mounted whiteboard marker holder; p1 sits on the rounded left cap end and p2 on the far coloured end plug next to the aluminium frame.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Brand/model not readable; standard dry-erase markers measure about 127-152 mm (5-6 in). Endpoints are within a few pixels of the visible ends, so the derived distance should correspond to the marker full length.

anchors.description: Full tip-to-tail length of the lower black-capped dry-erase marker in the same whiteboard holder
anchors.visible_evidence: Second dry-erase marker directly below the first in the same holder, black cap at the left end and dark end plug at the right; its apparent length matches the upper marker.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Brand/model unknown; could be a mini marker, but the two co-held markers appear equal length, supporting a standard 127-152 mm size. Right endpoint sits on the dark end near the frame.
